plan.question: Capture a natural long PREPARE under a single polling watcher and compare its current-source path with Issue68.
plan.observer: atomic published in-flight call pointer, one watcher, no per-query timer/goroutine. Profile may perturb scheduling; no performance adoption claim.
plan.precision: microsecond caller/snapshot offsets; point-in-time profile is not entire wait attribution
plan.exit: one live SQL control, fixed8 natural runs on/off; SAME_PATH / DIFFERENT_PATH / PARTIAL / NO_USABLE_CAPTURE. No automatic sampling beyond this, no parameter change or fix/main/release.
